subject: P1/P2 response windows & temporary on‑call coverage exception request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ops@fintechco.com
Date: 2026-07-20T11:12:00-04:00
Subject: Inquiry: P1/P2 SLA & temporary on-call coverage exception

Hi Karthik,

We're getting close to our APAC launch (end of month) and I wanted to confirm Redwood's support response commitments for our account. The security and launch teams asked for written confirmation of:
- P1 response time (initial acknowledgement + next steps)
- P2 response time expectations
- On-call coverage hours and escalation path (APAC overnight coverage is a specific concern)

Given our current usage profile during APAC night hours, we'd like to request a temporary exception to the standard P1 response window: can Redwood agree to a 90-minute initial response SLA for P1 incidents between 23:00-07:00 SGT for the first 6 weeks post-launch?

Reasons:
- Our internal ops team will be thin while we ramp; the extended window gives us room to stabilize playbooks.
- We'll run a parallel monitoring cadence and agree to provide immediate triage context to help accelerate recovery.

If this is a possibility, please advise what controls/mitigations you need (contact list, escalation contacts, PagerDuty group, runbook access) and any paperwork (SLA amendment) we should sign. I've attached a short list of our SLA questions for reference.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Operations, FintechCo
Samantha.Lee@fintechco.com
Attachments: FintechCo_SLA_RQs.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: P1/P2 SLA & temporary on-call coverage exception

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear note and the attachment.

Short answer: we can support a temporary, scoped exception with guardrails. I'll outline our proposed approach below and loop in our on-call lead to confirm operational details.

Proposed approach (draft):
- Trial window: 6 weeks from launch date.
- P1 initial acknowledgement: standard is 30 minutes; exception window: 90 minutes between 23:00-07:00 SGT only. Outside that window standard SLA applies.
- P2: maintain standard response windows (4 business hours).
- Escalation: create a shared PagerDuty policy that notifies Redwood on-call + FintechCo ops; Redwood will document the primary escalation contacts and a secondary on-call engineer.
- Required on your side: centralized alert channel and access to the launch runbook; Redwood will require the contact list and a high-priority incident playbook.

I'll ask Laura to confirm on-call rota overlap, and Marissa will help with the contractual amendment. If this matches your needs, we can produce a short SLA amendment and a DocuSign link within 48 hours.

Next steps: Laura — can you confirm whether we have capacity for the proposed exception window and the suggested escalation path (PD group + second-tier notify)?

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: P1/P2 SLA & temporary on-call coverage exception

Thanks for looping me in, Karthik.

Operational confirmation: we can support the proposed, timeboxed exception with the following controls to limit risk:
- Coverage model: assign a named on-call engineer as primary for the APAC overnight window (23:00-07:00 SGT). Primary will be in-region where possible; if not, a designated follow-the-sun backup will be on standby.
- Escalation path:
  1) Primary on-call (Redwood PD group: Redwood-Oncall-Primary) — initial ack and triage.
  2) Secondary on-call (Redwood-Oncall-Secondary) — if no response/blocked for >45 minutes.
  3) Engineering manager escalation (pager + call) — for severity growth or cross-team coordination.
- PagerDuty rules: we will create a temporary PD schedule tied to your account and share the PD rules and escalation timeline.
- Runbook access: we need read access to the FintechCo launch runbook; a dedicated Slack channel for high-priority incidents is recommended.

Risk mitigations we will implement:
- Daily check-ins for the first 10 days post-launch with shared incident channel.
- Automated health checks for the most critical endpoints with alert thresholds agreed in advance.

Attachments: I drafted a short internal proposal (proposed_oncall_exception_20260722.docx) that lays out the schedule and PD routing. Marissa — can you draft the SLA amendment and the DocuSign stub so we can send to Samantha?

Laura Bennett
Head of On-Call Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: P1/P2 SLA & temporary on-call coverage exception

Hi Samantha — following up with final confirmation and next steps.

Summary of agreement:
- Temporary exception: P1 initial acknowledgement window extended to 90 minutes between 23:00-07:00 SGT for 6 weeks post-launch (start date = launch day).
- P2 windows unchanged.
- Operational controls: temporary PagerDuty schedule, named primary & secondary Redwood on-call contacts, shared Slack channel, daily check-ins for first 10 days, automated health checks.
- Documentation: SLA amendment (one-page) + DocuSign link to follow (Marissa to send).

Outstanding items for FintechCo to provide (please reply inline):
1) Final launch date
2) Access to the launch runbook or a copy of the high-priority playbook
3) Primary FintechCo contact for PD and a backup

I've attached the DocuSign placeholder link (SLA_amendment_docusign_link.txt) and included the HubSpot deal for reference. If we get final launch date and contacts by EOD tomorrow, Marissa will issue the DocuSign and we can consider this agreed for the trial period.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
